paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: The primary text of arXiv:2609.05641v1 studies factorized low-precision matrix products under independent, zero-mean per-entry subtractive-dither errors and explicitly excludes correlated errors (Assumption 3.1, §3.1). It therefore establishes adjacent product-weighted dither theory but does not disclose this candidate mechanism of a shared per-sample draw, per-call phase table, and full W4A8 WAM action-endpoint calibration; the candidate survives as an incremental empirical mechanism.
paper_pointed_threat.parametric_family_concern: Soft signal: classical subtractive-dither quantization and correlated quantization-error shaping are mature families worth a bounded scoop-check for ‘common-random dither across layers’ and ‘phase-offset error-shaping calibration’; this is not evidence of exact overlap.

falsification_structure_check.reasoning: The proposal names a trajectory-held-out, paired-draw W4A8 pilot, compares learned phases against RTN, independent dither, site permutation, and direct endpoint PTQ, and predicts lower held-out full action-chunk MSE. The permutation arm measures the downstream outcome rather than Φ itself; symmetric no-op subregimes warrant cautious interpretation but do not remove the specified outcome test.

phase3_critique/phase3_critique_output.j.verdict_rationale: No B finding is present, and the closest retrieved primary paper explicitly excludes correlated errors, so neither the hard-floor overlap rule nor an upheld blocker fires. The falsification paragraph is structurally sound, but executed regime check N1 shows a legal all-zero activation row yields Δ=0 and x/Δ=0/0; this undefined core operation requires one tactical repair.
